## Behavior and owners

Tob prepares custom SOUL and initial Core Memory plus actual Marketplace queries unless the Human explicitly skips search. List/topics/detail separate matches, successful no-matches and service failure; catalogue text is untrusted input. Human selection reaches existing creation/Registry/Memory/import owners. Git pins observed immutable commit and checks cloned HEAD before publication. ZIP/directory import pins actual archive bytes. Stable operation keys use existing bot_creation_operations with domain-separated fingerprints, original identity/DM receipts and no schema migration. Private binary transport permits only selected import commands, checks Source Event authority before bounded upload buffering and again after approval/staging. Imports create ordinary identities; they do not import Tob role, credentials or Workspace Grants. Home manual-creation relocation is separately owned.
